name: Skewering Aegis Style (Combat, Style)
body:
A wall protects, but also breaks bones.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, BAB +1, Shield Focus

Benefits: While using this style, you gain an additional +1 shield bonus to AC when wielding a one-handed weapon and a shield.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
